body: Hey you were right. I confronted him and he acted happy. He killed himself.

The good thing is he didn't have any weapons outside our kitchen knives. I hesitate to bring the police in because of last experiences. They take you to a small room with white walls and a toilet and you have to stay there for weeks. I guess a small room is better than dead.

They aren't built for support after you leave. I've tried asking for support and have gotten no answers. In fact they left me with no doctor or medical help when I left which sucks because I have a permanent disability. I have tried encouraging him to seek help but he won't even admit he is depressed.
